name: manual_10116c
claim: Mask vs Fix principle: mask makes symptom disappear without removing root condition; fix removes condition so it cannot recur. Acceptable masks: time-boxed workaround for confirmed upstream bug. Unacceptable: resource leaks, concurrency bugs, security behavior. PR #69 singleFork was a mask — rejected upstream, removed in Vitest 4.
